subject: Renewal onboarding checkpoint + capacity increase (procurement steps)
messages:
From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@aristonhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@aristonhealth.com>, ProcureOps <procureops@aristonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Jan 2027 18:12:00 -0500
Subject: Renewal and onboarding refresh for Q2 capacity bump

Hi Ben —

Hope you had a good holiday. We're entering our fiscal Q2 planning and want to lock in the renewal for our Redwood account. Two asks from procurement/ops: 

1) Formalize the SOW addendum for a 30% capacity increase effective at renewal (current term ends 2027-03-31).
2) Refresh vendor onboarding/access in our procurement portal so our security and legal teams can re-run their checks (SOC2 artifacts, contact list, SCIM provisioning details).

Timeline: procurement would like all paperwork and portal onboarding completed by 2027-02-15 to hit internal approval board on 2027-02-20.

Can you confirm Redwood's procurement contact and provide the portal invitation link + a redlined addendum draft? Also flag any items likely to need legal review.

Thanks,
Karen Liu\Senior Procurement Manager\Ariston Health

Attachments: none in this initial email

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@aristonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal and onboarding refresh for Q2 capacity bump

Karen — thanks for the clear timeline. Happy to run this down. Quick plan below and next steps: 

- I've attached a proposed SOW addendum (Ariston_SOW_Addendum_v2.pdf) with the 30% capacity increase and proposed term alignment. Please review pricing table on page 2.
- I'll send a procurement portal invite to ProcureOps today (you should see an email with the onboarding checklist and an .ics for a short walkthrough).
- For legal: the addendum only changes capacity and billing cadence; however, there is a new data retention clause in section 4.3 that legal may want to redline.
- To expedite approvals, can you confirm: a) who signs the PO (name/title/email), b) whether your security team needs a SOC2 AICPA letter or the full evidence bundle?

Proposed milestone dates (we can tighten):
- Portal invite and addendum sent: 2027-01-05 (today)
- Procurement checklist completed by Ariston: 2027-01-20
- Legal signoff + PO by Ariston: 2027-02-10
- DocuSign execution and billing start: 2027-03-01

I'll loop Marissa for pricing approval on any concession requests.

Best,
Ben Carter\Account Executive, Strategic Accounts\Redwood Inference\Attachments: Ariston_SOW_Addendum_v2.pdf; redwood_portal_invite.ics; pricing_breakdown_2027.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Karen Liu <karen.liu@aristonhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 10:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal and onboarding refresh for Q2 capacity bump

Thanks for the heads up Ben — looping in pricing. A couple internal notes: 

- We can accommodate the 30% capacity bump under the current committed tier with a tiered uplift structure (see pricing_breakdown_2027.xlsx).
- To meet Ariston's timeline I'm willing to approve a one-time onboarding credit equal to 1 month of overage if procurement signs by 2027-02-10. This is a discretionary concession; please confirm Ariston will finalize PO by that date.
- Legal: Rachel, please review the data retention clause in section 4.3. If we keep our standard language but include an opt-out appendix for specific dataset classes, is that acceptable?

Ben — if Karen confirms the signatory and SOC2 scope today, I'll mark this as approved and we can prep the DocuSign packet.

Marissa Cole\Director, Commercial Ops\Redwood Inference

--
Marissa Cole\Director, Commercial Ops\Redwood Inference

Ben / Marissa —

Short answers: 
- Signatory: I (Tom Weaver) will sign the PO (SVP, IS Operations) — tom.weaver@aristonhealth.com
- SOC2: Our security team needs the full evidence bundle (not just the letter) for the onboarding checklist. We can provide a secure SFTP or share a presigned link.
- Timeline: the approval board meets 2027-02-20; we'll aim for your suggested internal signoff by 2027-02-10.

We'll accept the onboarding credit as long as the PO is in DocuSign and the addendum matches the capacity numbers in the SOW. Please proceed with the DocuSign packet and the portal handoff.

Tom Weaver\SVP, IS Operations\Ariston Health
